After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.

sky cinema comedy.title: Yesterday
sky cinema comedy.desc: Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
sky cinema comedy.desc: After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.

sky cinema comedy.title: Instant Family
sky cinema comedy.desc: When Pete and Ellie decide to start a family, they stumble into the world of foster care adoption. They hope to take in one small child, but when they meet three siblings, including a rebellious 15-year-old girl, they find themselves speeding from zero to three kids overnight. Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect
sky cinema comedy.desc: When a new student joins her college's female a cappella group, she takes the women out of their comfort zone of traditional pieces and introduces them to innovative arrangements.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect 2
sky cinema comedy.desc: Now graduating seniors, the Barden Bellas enter an international a cappella competition which no American team has ever won.

sky cinema comedy.title: Pitch Perfect 3
sky cinema comedy.desc: After the highs of winning the world championships, the Bellas find themselves split apart. But when they get the chance to reunite for an overseas USO tour, this group of awesome nerds will come together to make some music one last time.

sky cinema comedy.title: Dumb & Dumber
sky cinema comedy.desc: A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.

sky cinema comedy.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
sky cinema comedy.desc: A grant-greedy principal puts two clueless teens in a bogus class for students with special needs.

sky cinema comedy.title: Team America: World Police
sky cinema comedy.desc: A gung-ho, `Thunderbirds'-style squad of puppets lead America's war on terrorism. The creators of `South Park' go on the offensive with an outrageous animated satire that makes a target of everyone from politicians to Hollywood liberals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Central Intelligence
sky cinema comedy.desc: A lethal CIA agent and his former classmate encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to save the U.S. spy satellite system.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Presence
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A family becomes convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: M3GAN 2.0
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A military-grade robotic weapon known as Amelia becomes increasingly self-aware and dangerous to the human race. Hoping to stop it, Gemma, an advocate for oversight of AI, decides to resurrect M3GAN, making it faster, stronger, and more lethal.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Star Trek
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: When the Federation receives a distress signal from planet Vulcan during a hearing to decide whether Kirk has cheated on his final test at the academy, his friend Dr McCoy sneaks him aboard the USS Enterprise as it sets out on its maiden voyage.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Damned
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Fighting for survival at an isolated fishing outpost, Eva and her crew are cursed after making the choice to not help a sinking ship off the coast. Facing the consequences, a darkness consumes them all, creating chaos and death at every turn.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Oblivion
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Two weeks before he is scheduled to depart from devastated planet Earth forever, a drone repairman rescues a woman from a downed spaceship, triggering a final battle to save mankind.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Chronicles of Riddick
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Constantine
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: M3GAN 2.0
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A military-grade robotic weapon known as Amelia becomes increasingly self-aware and dangerous to the human race. Hoping to stop it, Gemma, an advocate for oversight of AI, decides to resurrect M3GAN, making it faster, stronger, and more lethal.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Exorcist
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A famous actress calls upon medical science for help when her daughter begins behaving strangely, but without any success. Then, as bizarre and horrific incidents involving the daughter increase, her mother turns in desperation to the Church, and to a priest who doubts his own faith.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Damned
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Fighting for survival at an isolated fishing outpost, Eva and her crew are cursed after making the choice to not help a sinking ship off the coast. Facing the consequences, a darkness consumes them all, creating chaos and death at every turn.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema thriller.title: Murder by Numbers
sky cinema thriller.desc: A troubled female cop must unravel the perfect murder as she matches wits with two homicidal schoolboys, who believe they can't be caught after committing a motiveless crime. As she gets ever closer to the truth she at once alienates her new partner and puts her own life in peril.

sky cinema thriller.title: Hungry
sky cinema thriller.desc: After becoming lost in the Louisiana swamplands, a group of holidaymakers must fight for their lives against a rampaging hippo on the loose.

sky cinema thriller.title: Sherlock Holmes
sky cinema thriller.desc: Detective Sherlock Holmes and his stalwart partner Watson engage in a battle of wits and brawn with a nemesis whose plot is a threat to all of England.

sky cinema thriller.title: Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows
sky cinema thriller.desc: The murder of Austria's crown prince leads Holmes, Watson and a Gypsy to a showdown with an evil genius named Moriarty.

sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me
sky cinema thriller.desc: A federal agent and an Interpol detective play a cat-and-mouse game with cunning illusionists who rob corrupt business leaders during their performances, then funnel the money to members of the audience.

sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me 2
sky cinema thriller.desc: A devious tech wizard forces the illusionists known as the Four Horsemen to steal a powerful chip that can control all of the world's computers.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: Fatal Attraction
sky cinema thriller.desc: A glamorous career woman loses control when her married lover, a Manhattan attorney, ends their brief affair. Unable to accept his rejection, she pursues him at the office, and then at his home, eventually drawing his wife and daughter into the confrontation.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Untouchables
sky cinema thriller.desc: Lavish thriller about an idealistic federal agent who vows to bring down Al Capone and his underworld crime syndicate in Prohibition-era Chicago. With police corruption rife, he forms a special team for the task and relies on a veteran street cop - passed over for promotion because he is honest - to clean up the force and trap Capone.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
sky cinema greats.desc: Kirk and the Enterprise crew defy Starfleet and return to the Genesis planet to reunite Spock's body and spirit.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
sky cinema greats.desc: Kirk and company travel back in time to 20th-century San Francisco, where two whales hold the key to Earth's future.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
sky cinema greats.desc: The Enterprise crew falls under the spell of Spock's half-brother, a renegade Vulcan on an obsessive quest to find God.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
sky cinema greats.desc: The Klingon Empire is falling apart and they want peace with the Federation. Hiowever, when an unprotected Klingon craft is fired on, Kirk and Dr McCoy are placed on trial for murder.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek Generations
sky cinema greats.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soren. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek: First Contact
sky cinema greats.desc: Picard and his crew face a Borg offensive as they try to ensure that a 21st-century scientist keeps a date with destiny.

sky cinema greats.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
sky cinema greats.desc: The crew of the Enterprise learns of a plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, and Capt Picard begins an open rebellion to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals the Federation was founded.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max
sky cinema greats.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior
sky cinema greats.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

sky cinema greats.title: Mad Max 3: Beyond Thunderdome
sky cinema greats.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

sky cinema greats.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
sky cinema greats.desc: Sequel unfolding a life-and-death battle to avert a nuclear holocaust. A supercomputer that sought to destroy humankind sends a virtually indestructible, shape-shifting cyborg back to our time to kill its enemy - the human resistance leader - in his youth. Aided by another cyborg, the boy and his mother try to alter the events that led to the computer's creation and the nuclear war which it triggered.

sky cinema greats.title: Innerspace
sky cinema greats.desc: A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. Attempts by his colleagues to retrieve the little man - protected inside a tiny submersible - are hampered by the would-be thieves.

sky cinema drama.title: Tommy
sky cinema drama.desc: Ken Russell's flamboyant treatment of the Who's rock opera about a deaf, dumb and blind boy who develops an extraordinary ability at pinball. Under his sinister stepfather's influence, he achieves fame and a cult following, but his almost messianic status also spells the beginning of his destruction.

sky cinema drama.title: Dreamgirls
sky cinema drama.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. They're going nowhere fast until they meet fast-talking car salesman-come-manager who has ambitions to make a fortune selling black music to a white audience. He persuades them to become backing singers for James `Thunder' Early, but the larger-than-life lead singer Effie White must step out of the spotlight in favour of the more image-friendly Deena Jones.

sky cinema drama.title: Footloose
sky cinema drama.desc: A rebellious teen incurs the wrath of a beloved clergyman by challenging the town's ban on loud music and dancing.

sky cinema drama.title: Footloose
sky cinema drama.desc: A rebellious teen incurs the wrath of a beloved clergyman by challenging the town's ban on loud music and dancing.

sky cinema drama.title: A Star Is Born
sky cinema drama.desc: Hard-drinking country music star Jackson Maine discovers, and falls in love with, a struggling but talented singer named Ally. As her career quickly takes off, Jackson starts to realize that his best days may be behind him.

sky cinema drama.title: Cast Away
sky cinema drama.desc: Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of Fedex snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.

sky cinema drama.title: Escape to Victory
sky cinema drama.desc: When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

sky cinema drama.title: Love Me
sky cinema drama.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

sky cinema drama.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
sky cinema drama.desc: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him.
